* Note: grab shortcut targets from Settings is only needed * if you depends on a value being set in the same call. * For example, you disable a single shortcut, * and you're checking if there is any shortcut remaining. * *

* If you just want to know the current state, you can use * {@link AccessibilityManager#getAccessibilityShortcutTargets(int)}
